passages.name: The Disturbance
passages.scene_context: The Codex trembles in your hand. A faint pulse flickers somewhere ahead.
passages.text: DEV NOTE: This pulse is the CoreLink node destabilizing after Kaelen's confession. The player should see a soft glow in the environment.

passages.name: The Activation
passages.scene_context: A faint pulsing glow appears near the cracked wall. It brightens slightly when the player moves toward it.
passages.text: DEV NOTE: No text tells the player to move. The glow itself is the affordance. The pulse frequency increases as the player approaches. Press E to interact.

passages.name: Interaction
passages.scene_context: On interaction, the glow flashes. A brief, fragmented image fills the screen — something from the player's past, unclear and out of order.
passages.text: DEV NOTE: This is the first hint that the player's walkabouts are surfacing their own buried memories. The image should be abstract, not literal. The projection settles into the player's palm.

passages.name: The Residual Echo
passages.scene_context: The corridor stays still. The Codex warms slightly.
passages.text: DEV NOTE: The system quiets after activation. No further interaction needed. The Glyph of Remembrance has been obtained.
